cn.description:
Heart Murmurs Pro 是一款心脏听诊训练工具，面向医学生、护理专业学生、住院医师，以及任何正在学习用耳朵分辨心音的人。

收录 24 种心音与心脏杂音。每一种都配有标注波形图，清楚显示该声音落在心动周期的哪个位置，还有对应听诊部位的示意图，以及配套的学习笔记。听完之后，可以立即自测。

这是学习材料，不是临床工具。其中任何内容都不用于指导对真实患者的诊疗决策。

免费试用

五种心音免费：正常心音、主动脉瓣狭窄、二尖瓣反流、二尖瓣狭窄与 S3 奔马律，每种都配有波形图、听诊部位与学习笔记，并可用它们自测。一次购买即可解锁其余 19 种心音以及下文的学习工具。无订阅。

内容包括

• 24 种心音与杂音：从正常 S1/S2，到主动脉瓣狭窄、二尖瓣反流、肥厚型梗阻性心肌病、心包摩擦音、重叠奔马律
• 每种声音都有标注波形图，标出收缩期与舒张期，并在实际发生的位置标示 S1、S2、A2、P2、喷射音、开瓣音与奔马律
• 半速播放，适合听清那些一闪而过的杂音
• 任意两种心音对比：杂音可与正常心音对照，也可与你常混淆的那种对照，一键切换
• 听诊部位示意图，标示每种声音在何处听得最清楚
• 每种声音配有七部分学习笔记：描述、病因、病理生理、体格检查、诊断评估、临床表现与治疗
• 可为任意声音添加个人笔记

自我测验

自行选择练习范围——全部心音、内置分组、收藏，或你自己勾选的几种——再选择题数，即可开始。五题用于快速练习，二十题用于时间充裕时。可从六个选项中作答，也可以自己说出名称并为自己的回忆评分。

开启「重问」后，答错的心音会在几道题之后再次出现，因为那正是你需要重听的那一个。结束时除了成绩，更有价值的是答错清单，并可一键只练习这些。每种心音都会单独记录你的表现，应用据此显示你的薄弱之处，并直接据此组织一次练习。

为学习而设计

• 完全离线可用：无需账号、无需登录、无需任何设置
• 免费下载；一次购买解锁全部，无订阅、无广告
• 支持简体中文、英文与西班牙文
• iPad 完整分栏视图
• 深色模式
• 全库收藏与搜索
• 心脏体格检查指南，涵盖听诊技术、五个听诊区，以及描述杂音的八项特征

强烈建议使用耳机。手机扬声器会削弱低频，而 S3、S4 与二尖瓣狭窄正处于低频区。

Heart Murmurs Pro 是用于学习心脏听诊的教育工具，并非诊断设备，不得用于诊断或治疗任何人，也不得用于指导对患者的诊疗决策。请始终以你所受的训练、上级医师的指导以及所在机构的规程为准。

tr.description:
Lead Japan's merchant fleet to import resources and export goods!
Engage in trade, power up domestic industries, and drive the rapid growth of the Japanese economy!

Japan relies on imports for many of its essential resources, with 99% of these shipments transported by merchant vessels such as tankers and bulk carriers.
Imported resources are processed domestically into various goods for export, generating foreign currency. Merchant ships—including container ships and car carriers—play a vital role in these exports as well.

Building a merchant ship can take two to three years or more; consequently, many shipping companies secure the vessels they operate by leasing them from shipowners (a practice known as "chartering").


Use your merchant fleet to handle imports and exports, activate key domestic industries, and fuel the growth of the Japanese economy!
There are just two main tasks for the player:

1.
Charter merchant ships! You can sign contracts by selecting the charter period, ship type, and vessel size. Once chartered, simply choose your trading partners and the goods to be traded, and the ships will set sail.

2.
Operate essential domestic industries! By supplying valuable resources to these industries, you can manufacture products. These goods can be consumed domestically or sold as exports to earn foreign currency. Infrastructure that generates energy cannot be allowed to stop; oil, LNG (liquefied natural gas), and coal are vital to the Japanese economy. Make sure to keep imports flowing!


It’s "Game Over" if you run out of any of the essentials for infrastructure and daily life: oil, LNG, coal, food, or money. Keep a close eye on your resource stockpiles as you manage the Japanese economy!


There are absolutely no advertisements or in-app purchases—feel free to focus entirely on the gameplay.

Run Japan's trains!

No railroad knowledge is required to play "Tokyo Train!".
This game is a brain game with simple rules but requires a lot of brain power.


Customers are waiting at the station for the trains to arrive to take them to their destinations.
Start the trains and transport your customers.

You will earn money for every passenger who boards a train.
Adjust the interval between runs and the number of cars to achieve the highest revenue.
Departing trains costs money. If you send out too many trains and the boarding rate drops, you will lose your revenue.

The operation method is very easy and the rules are simple.
All you have to do is adjust the number of train cars and make the trains depart at the best time.
As the game progresses, express fares will also appear.

No technical knowledge is required at all.
Both people who like trains and people who like games can quickly understand and enjoy the game.

There are no in-app purchases. There are no ads.
Please concentrate on the game.
Share your operating results on social media.

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace.

HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:

Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner!

These goods can be consumed domestically or sold as exports to earn foreign currency. Infrastructure that generates energy cannot be allowed to stop; oil, LNG (liquefied natural gas), and coal are vital to the Japanese economy. Make sure to keep imports flowing!


It’s "Game Over" if you run out of any of the essentials for infrastructure and daily life: oil, LNG, coal, food, or money. Keep a close eye on your resource stockpiles as you manage the Japanese economy!
